name: antifragile-harness
description: EU AI Act (Reg. 2024/1689) + Digital Omnibus (Reg. 2026/1744) compliance harness for Claude Code: 24 offline analyzers (incl. MCP toolchain and Claude Code security), founder 3-bucket triage, SARIF 2.1.0 and Claude Compliance API / claude-security ingestion, release dossier, and a 13-tool MCP server. The plugin starts its bundled engine with uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/), so uv must be on PATH; there is nothing else to install.

antifragile-harness.description: Runs the engine bundled with this plugin through uv, so its version always matches the plugin. Replaces the root .mcp.json entry of the same name, which runs antifragile-scan-mcp from PATH for development and other MCP clients.
